products.name: Decktopus
products.note: AI presentation maker; automated design; content generation; data exposure

reading.body:
Decktopus is an AI presentation tool that generates complete decks from topic descriptions or uploaded files, automating structure, content, and design work for users.

The product sits in a narrow but growing category: software that reduces friction in knowledge work by handling the mechanical parts of document creation. A user provides raw material—a topic, a file, or a URL—and the tool produces a finished artifact. This works because presentation design and structure follow learned patterns that language models can replicate. The company's claim that it does not use customer data for training, combined with encryption standards and SOC 2 compliance progress, suggests it is aware that enterprises using the tool need assurance against data leakage. Zapier integration and ChatGPT availability indicate strategy to embed the tool into existing workflows rather than draw users to a standalone platform.

What this does not show is whether Decktopus has solved the unit economics of AI-powered tools or achieved differentiation beyond automation. The data covers product features, security posture, and hosting infrastructure, but contains no information about user adoption, revenue, retention, or competitive position. The data exposure flag indicates a security incident or vulnerability, but provides no detail on scope or resolution. A reader cannot assess whether this represents a durable business or a capability that will commoditize into larger platforms.

profile_text.body:
Decktopus is an AI presentation maker. According to its site, a user types a presentation title or describes a topic and the tool generates a complete deck including structure, content, and design, with no outline or blank slide needed. The company says decks are built around the user's specific message rather than a shared template. Existing presentations can be uploaded and redesigned, with colors, layout, and type changed while the content stays as it is, and a website URL can be entered so the tool pulls in brand colors, fonts, and logo.

The site says Decktopus AI is available as an app inside ChatGPT, where users tag @Decktopus AI in a chat, and that it connects to other tools through Zapier so presentation generation can be triggered from CRM updates, form submissions, or other workflows. Users can create reusable slide templates for the AI to fill in. Slides can be edited after generation with Edit with AI or Edit Text, restored from Version History, or regenerated with a new prompt, and decks can be shared by link, exported as PDF, PPT, or PNG, or presented directly. The company states there is no free plan, but new users get free credits at signup for a 3 slide presentation. On security, it says data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256, hosted on AWS infrastructure, that personal workspaces are accessible only to the user and shared workspaces are limited to authorized members, that customer data is not used for AI training, and that SOC 2 Type II compliance is in progress. The site also carries user testimonials, including one describing use for a Series A pitch deck.

The product is tracked as an AI presentation maker with automated design and content generation, and the record notes data exposure as a consideration. There is no litigation listed and no MCP server recorded.
